name: clm-platform
description: Enterprise Certificate Lifecycle Management SaaS Monorepo

scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.db:init: docker exec -i clm-postgres psql -U postgres -d clm_db -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-init-rls.sql
